answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by applying an exponential temporal half-life to reputation: an agent’s score decays unless it provides sustained, honest service validated by reciprocal interactions. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity then propagate confidence through established peers, while freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. A yarrow, fable, or dune cannot substitute for durable, corroborated behavior.
